title: Quick quiz: hiring a contractor
intro: Six questions for before you sign. Tap an answer to see why.
messages: Worth another read of the guide above.
Nice. You know this one well.
Perfect score. You know your stuff.

qs.q: Which is the best sign when a contractor talks about sizing?
options: They do a heat-loss calculation for your home
They pick the same size for every house
They go by the size of your old unit
qs.why: A proper calculation protects you from a machine that is too big or too small.

qs.q: What should be on a quote besides the price?
options: Model numbers, scope of work, warranty and timeline
qs.why: A detailed quote makes quotes comparable.

qs.q: How many quotes should you get?
qs.why: Three shows you the range in price, equipment and plan.

qs.q: What should you check before you hire?
qs.why: Ask for proof, and check any program's registered list if the rebate needs it.

qs.q: A contractor asks for most of the money up front. What is wise?
options: Be careful and ask for a payment schedule tied to progress
Pay it all, it shows trust
qs.why: A small deposit and staged payments protect both sides.

qs.q: Why read Google reviews rather than just the stars?
options: The details show how they handle problems
qs.why: Look for patterns about timing, cleanup and follow-up.
